Use the existing sun/Daylight wordmark without its Medicare subtitle and retain Get started. This supersedes the earlier exact-tagline rule only for :8893's landing presentation; preserve all layout, font, palette, photo and interaction decisions. Protected variants retain their earlier copy. [Scoped change and responsive evidence](audit-evidence/landing-medicare-20261102/README.md).

scopeNotes.scope: Review criteria; not new visual or flow authority.
scopeNotes.sourceText: **D73 strategic review · October 25, 2026:** Follow the [canonical thesis and UI/system checklist](docs/product/STRATEGIC_THESIS.md#ui-and-system-change-review-checklist). Design for useful self-service and comprehension: questions before extensive intake, progressive correction, coverage paths before policies, consistent cost/access/restriction/future-flexibility tradeoffs, and inspectable evidence. Keep sample browsing distinct from recommendations and customer completeness distinct from external verification. Family sharing and human support require actual permissioned capability. This adds review criteria, not a new layout, intake sequence, tagline or permission to replace the accepted simple adaptive chat.

scopeNotes.scope: D65 supersedes the permanent task composer; retained composer styling is not current placement guidance.
scopeNotes.sourceText: D65 replaces the permanent task composer with a compact authored sun-agent launcher labeled **Ask Daylight · AI assistant**, beneath Continue/Back. Something else opens the same overlay in answer mode; help opens conversation mode. The overlay preserves drafts. Send creates a proposal only; **Confirm and continue** explicitly records reviewed/edited reports and proceeds to the previewed next task. No extraction, selection or response automatically advances. Keep raw text and unresolved facts in the current tab. The starting-profile dialog uses the picture/dialog radius and structural overlay shadow.

scopeNotes.scope: D65 Ask geometry supersedes the older 466px frontmatter width for the guided overlay. This does not prescribe D92 Plans chat geometry.
scopeNotes.sourceText: Ask is an overlay over the picture side, never a new grid column or reflow. Background inert, contained focus, no automatic keyboard when opening for reading, visible Return/Escape, exact opener/scroll/draft recovery. Single reading area, question before answer, sources and visible follow-ups. Phone sheet adapts to available height/keyboard. D65 supersedes the prior 466px width: desktop is 600px (bounded by viewport minus 32px); phone uses viewport minus 20px with 10px side insets. The inherited overlay caps height relative to the available dynamic viewport.

narrative.overview:
Approved reference · October 21, 2026 · Candidate02 layout and selected Option A. Preserve the warm paper, sage teaching surfaces, olive actions, readable Atkinson Hyperlegible body and Fraunces display relationship. This is a canonical record of the approved system, not a new aesthetic direction or a new slogan.

The only brand tagline is exactly **Your coverage, plain as day**. Keep the sun/name. Do not add a header kicker, secondary slogan, fabricated testimonial or decorative motion.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, professional surfaces and meaningful photography.
One visible task, a deliberate Continue and a growing teaching picture.
Large readable type, explicit text labels and visible keyboard focus.
Equal comparison emphasis and visible evidence/unknown distinctions.
dos: **Do** preserve the approved Candidate02 layout and exact Option A asset with its provenance, license and crop evidence.
**Do** preserve the sun/name and the sole exact tagline **Your coverage, plain as day**.
**Do** keep the current task, reason, compact lesson and deliberate Continue easy to find.
**Do** preserve explicit Back, edit, help, actual answers/notes, adaptive branches and factual safeguards.
**Do** record D IDs, nodes, state effects, checks, before-images and remaining limits for a scoped implementation.
**Do** inspect desktop, tablet and phone behavior as part of implementation; document extraction does not establish rendered acceptance.
donts: **Don't** add a header kicker, secondary slogan, fabricated testimonial, decorative motion or a new visual identity.
**Don't** reopen the approved layout or replace the photograph without a new owner decision.
**Don't** infer mastery, health/customer status, endorsement or personally suitable coverage from presentation or imagery.
**Don't** remove lessons, adaptive branches, factual safeguards or catalog behavior to simplify the interface.
**Don't** preselect answers, require age-65 arithmetic, use hidden gestures or make choices advance automatically.
**Don't** treat styling, documentation or a test count as validation of participant comprehension, all accessibility criteria, live AI, secure guest persistence or personal insurance fit.
